correctness.rationale: The D4 root 24-cell has precisely 24 octahedral facets, each one an isolated nonsimplicial 4-cone; its proper faces are unimodular. Small toric resolutions cannot introduce rays and each octahedron admits exactly 3 tetrahedralizations by choosing its opposite-vertex diagonal. Every tetrahedron is D4-unimodular (288 candidate determinant values ±1); facet intersections are triangles, permitting independent choices. Exceptional two-cone star is P1×P1 and different singular fixed-point fibers are disjoint. Boundary pulling of a global order gives at least one coherent/projective choice. For any choice, simplicial f=(24,120,192,96) yields h=(1,20,54,20,1), and standard toric cohomology gives vanishing odd Betti. Independent exact coordinate/facet determinant computation enumerated 24 facets, 288 determinant checks and the same f-vector, corroborating the geometric proof.
